title: Sprang a scourging race from thee--

events.sourceSentence: Once, when flying high above a mountainous country, he caught a glimpse of Atlas, his pale face turned up to the heavens, whose weight he had patiently borne for many a long year,--a burden which seemed all the more grievous after the short taste of freedom he had enjoyed while Hercules stood in his place (pp.
